meta: Make a budget grocery list with AI, because shopping without a list is the fastest way to overspend.

muc.title: Overspending at the market
muc.text: Shopping without a list is the fastest way to overspend, buy too much and waste it.

muc.title: Say the amount
muc.text: Tell a chatbot your budget for the week, how many people eat and the family's favorite dishes. Ask for a list sorted by section.

muc.title: AI doesn't know market prices
muc.text: AI doesn't know today's prices. Write down prices for a few things you buy often, and ask it to total them and show where to cut.

muc.title: Switch to cheaper dishes
muc.text: For anything over budget, ask AI for a cheaper option the family will still enjoy, like swapping beef for eggs or tofu.

muc.title: A list for tomorrow
muc.text: Write down tomorrow's grocery budget and ask AI for a list that fits it.
